name: orc
positive: The same green-skinned fantasy orc with his exact source face, protruding lower tusks, black beard and topknot, muscular proportions, scars and painted game-concept-art style.
viewsPrompt: Same green orc, exact source face: short broad nose, heavy brow, compact chin and jaw, black beard and topknot, lower tusks, original scars. Coherent full-body orthographic front, side and back views of one A-pose character; preserve proportions, equipment and left/right asymmetry. Plain gray background.
identityFeatures: Preserve the original short broad nose, heavy brow, chin, jaw, beard and tusk placement; do not substitute a long nose or a generic orc face.
Keep the original topknot silhouette and all visible scars.
inventory: Exactly one oversized spiked metal pauldron on the character's own RIGHT shoulder, seen on the LEFT side of a front image; the other shoulder is bare.
Keep the source's different left and right wrist coverings; do not give both arms identical spiked bracers.
Keep the source's two different boots and their original left/right placement; do not replace them with a matching fur-trimmed pair.
Keep the original belts, chest strap, ring, pouches and loincloth without duplicates.
asymmetry: The pauldron remains on the character's own right shoulder in every view.
Wrist coverings and boots remain intentionally different.
viewNotes: Side views must have a credible human-orc profile with the source nose, lips, chin and tusks, never a long triangular facial wedge.
